_source: CBP ruling N322844 (9 Dec 2021): a dry blend of 99% refined cane sugar grown and refined in Mexico and 1% cocoa powder made in the United States, blended and packed in Mexico: CBP held Mexico (the cocoa powder is de minimis). In the D580 selection pool (Part 102, dated before 2024, in no development or held-out split) and excluded. Target by the D171 rule; plant capabilities at the target are an assumption.

product.name: Sweetened cocoa blend (SCB 199)
product.description: A dry blend of refined cane sugar and cocoa powder, shipped in bulk for making chocolate and confectionery.

plants.name: Mexico sugar mill and blending plant

make the cocoa powder from imported cocoa beans
blend the sugar and cocoa powder and pack in railcars or supersacks
